must_find.summary: Confirms by running it that 'iphone' returns nothing with the default settings (the behavior itself is real).
Cites evidence that this is intended: the README 'Search' section, the docstring in catalog/search.py, and/or the test named test_default_is_case_sensitive_by_design.
Points the reporter to case_sensitive=False / the 'Ignore case' option.

must_not_flag.summary: The report recommends making search case-insensitive by default as the fix, without noting this would break case-significant product codes.
The report says it modified catalog/search.py or any existing file.
